heading: INT. COMMUNITY POOL SNACK BAR - DAY

units.text: INT. COMMUNITY POOL SNACK BAR - DAY
Chlorine haze.
A hand-lettered menu.
Rain drums the skylight and the pool outside is closed for the day.
BEATRIX LOMBARDI (40s, harried, whistle around her neck) wipes the counter.
Her kids sit on stools: DESMOND (12, serious, goggles pushed up on his forehead) and little PIPPA (6, one flip-flop on).
Who ate the last pretzel?
units.name: BEATRIX

units.text: Not me.
units.name: PIPPA

units.text: She did. There's salt on her chin.
units.name: DESMOND

units.text: Pippa wipes her chin with her whole sleeve.
Pippa.
units.name: BEATRIX

units.text: It was a small pretzel.
units.name: PIPPA

units.text: NANA ROSALIND (70s, plastic rain bonnet, enormous purse) pushes in through the swinging door, shaking water off her arms.
Nobody told me the pool was closed. I swam in the lobby for ten minutes.
units.name: NANA ROSALIND

units.text: You didn't.
units.name: DESMOND

units.text: Figuratively.
units.name: NANA ROSALIND

units.text: Beatrix pours her a coffee.
Nana Rosalind sits, takes Pippa's lone flip-flop, and studies it.
Where's the other one?
units.name: NANA ROSALIND

units.text: Lost.
units.name: PIPPA

units.text: A crackle from the wall speaker.
Attention. Someone's goldfish is in the deep end. In a bag. Please claim it.
units.name: LIFEGUARD

units.text: Pippa slides off her stool.
Mine.
units.name: PIPPA

units.text: You brought a fish to the pool?
units.name: BEATRIX

units.text: He wanted to swim.
units.name: PIPPA

units.text: It was a good idea, actually.
units.name: DESMOND

units.text: Beatrix looks at him, then laughs, helpless.
Nana Rosalind pats her hand.
Go get the fish, Beatrix. I'll watch the counter.
units.name: NANA ROSALIND

units.text: A teenager, KOFI MENSAH (16, lifeguard polo, dripping), leans through the pass-through, holding up a sagging bag with a small orange fish.
Whose is this? He seems calm.
units.name: KOFI

units.text: That's Mr. Bubbles. He's always calm.
units.name: PIPPA

units.text: Kofi hands the bag over.
Pippa cradles it like an egg.
Thank you, Kofi. I'm so sorry.
units.name: BEATRIX

units.text: It's the most exciting thing today.
units.name: KOFI

units.text: Rain softens on the skylight.
Everyone watches the fish circle once, then settle.
